from the article

He also warned against another innovation that threatens press freedom - the forging by clubs of partnerships with select media outlets, usually due to commercial tie-ups, which gives them exclusive access.

I can see this becoming very popular as it would be a good source of revenue for clubs if they give exclusive access to specific media outlets. It seems that any part of football that can be bundled up and monetized regardless, of the loss of value to the fans, will be done.
